subject: Abbreviated combined relation conditions
notes: kb/Work PB1390 landed (wave 68 s). Rule 2): the omission of the subject and relational operator; "Within a sequence of relation conditions, both forms of omission may be used." (cite.py --check 8.8.4.12.1 OK). A bare object (and NOT + bare object) is the unaryLogicalExpression arm of succeedingCondition, reachable after every connective — including after an OR-led abbreviated relation, where the earlier chain rule had admitted only further abbreviated relations (A = B OR < C AND D was COBOL0001). BindSoleOperandCondition reads it against the carried subject and operator. Goldens E1/E2/E4/E5 (85), X4/X5/X6 (2023): 0 disagreements over 81 tuples. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Frontend/Grammar/Core/CobolExpressions.g4#abbreviatedAndChain (kb/Work PB1390 deleted the OR-only abbreviatedAndChain rule (it admitted no bare object after its AND); the bare object is succeedingCondition's unaryLogicalExpression arm)
